text: EventModelBuilder TermRows already preserves sourceRows through subset and missing-value masks, but eventTermEither None passes only events/onsets/durations/blockIds/tag to EventTerm.validated. Unphased compiled terms therefore lack source-row identity, while phase terms carry EventRowProvenance. Reproduce via ordinary public builder with noncontiguous subset and missing-row selection; add general source-row representation without inventing parent trial identities. Preserve phase provenance, trial-term rows, actual source indices through filtering, and design/provenance fingerprint semantics. Verify JVM/JS and BIDS consumer before adoption. Prerequisite for source-addressable response support and exclusions; consumer plsneuro bd-01M1VKM2RSV5DZ56FEN7CK2WCA. No source data rewriting.
